facts.fact: The Rwanda Investigation Bureau's own history states that it has incorporated the Integrated Electronic Case Management System to process criminal investigation files, and that the handling of cases is digitalised from investigation to final judgment through it; the book gives no date for this, so the date is its publication (it covers 2017 to 2023).
The Rwanda Investigation Bureau's history states that the Integrated Electronic Case Management System is managed by the Ministry of Justice; no date is given, so the date is the book's publication.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice (manages); used by the Rwanda Investigation Bureau for criminal investigation files
systems.tiers: From investigation to final judgment; the passages do not say whether RIB stations and posts enter the files or where

systems.owner: INTERPOL National Central Bureau, Kigali (within RIB)
systems.tiers: Manned by the NCB and extended to the Rwanda National Police, the prosecution authority, the revenue authority and the immigration directorate

systems.country_label: NCB Border Support dashboard; NCB Dashboard that monitors Stop Lists on Rwandan borders
systems.tiers: Supports immigration and the revenue authority; an NCB representative at all borders
Listed among RIB's intentions for the way forward: to build one
A unit of 7 in RIB's structure, beside crime statistics and report staff; medium not stated

systems.country_label: Digital Forensic unit; in-house forensic laboratory

systems.tiers: Receives and orients crime reporting; crimes can be reported in person or by other means

note: Passages only, and the two IECMS passages are cut short by the extraction. The system is classed record because the investigating body says its investigation files are processed in it; the document does not say that stations or posts make the entry, give how the record is made, or count units, so there is no made or stations fact. The body is the Rwanda Investigation Bureau, separated from the National Police in 2017-2018, not the police: the parent decides whether its stations count. 'From investigation to the final judgment' also bears on the justice-linked flag.
